name: operations.strategy_rules

list.description: Read native main or sub strategy rule records in one explicit category.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Native strategy category; each acquisition covers one category.

parameters.name: strategy-type
parameters.description: Sub strategy type; repeat to select types. Omission selects the three UI types. Invalid with main category.

summary: Native main and sub strategy rule records.
purpose: Inspect native strategy configuration records and versions without editing or resolving referenced rules.

fields.name: strategyRuleId
fields.meaning: Logical strategy rule ID; distinct versions may share this value.

fields.name: strategyRuleContent
fields.meaning: Native strategy content, retained without parsing or joining referenced IDs.

fields.name: strategyCategory
fields.meaning: Explicit native main or sub category.

fields.name: strategyType
fields.meaning: Native sub strategy type; selected independently of category.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Native rule state, distinct from approval/process state.

identity_description: Native physical id identifies each returned rule record; logical rule IDs and versions remain separate.
limitations: List only; no independent detail/history, referenced-rule joins or business actions.
Native strategyRuleContent remains unchanged, including source string encoding.
Native main records may carry strategyCategory SUB_STRATEGY with an empty strategyType; request-defined capture scope remains MAIN_DECISION_STRATEGY and source fields are preserved.

sync.evidence: Native physical id identifies each returned rule record; logical rule IDs and versions remain separate. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
